metadata.purpose: Simplified PPWR-based MVP0 test fixtures for software validation only.
metadata.note: Do not present these rules as complete or authoritative PPWR compliance logic.

rules.name: Heavy metals total limit
rules.description: MVP0 numeric maximum test for total lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium.

rules.name: Food-contact PFAS compliance
rules.description: MVP0 uses a pre-evaluated boolean instead of reproducing the full PFAS analytical thresholds.

rules.name: Minimum recycled content sample threshold
rules.description: Simplified 2030 MVP0 threshold used only to exercise screening logic for the sample PET beverage package.

rules.name: Recyclability readiness placeholder
rules.description: Boolean sample rule to test architecture. This is not a PPWR recyclability score or full design-for-recycling assessment.

rules.name: Compostability sample applicability rule
rules.description: Included to test NOT_APPLICABLE handling. It does not apply to the MVP0 bottle body, cap, or ordinary label sample.
